C-CI-RUST-PLATFORM-CANCELLATION-VERIFICA.Summary: Correct platform-specific Rust lifecycle verification after real Windows parent cancellation, while preserving production helper behavior and proving direct runner cancellation plus bounded exact-child escalation.
C-CI-RUST-PLATFORM-CANCELLATION-VERIFICA.Problem: PR275 headfcbc1b4b6d7186c8ee06d7114ac466da539f59d7, mergecheckout02b7ab78c7fbf546a6b790aabb6051011d7bf9c2, Windows renderer job132955277341 produced three real fixture failures. Parent cancellation status130/143, native PID absence and owned-file cleanup assertions passed, but inner runner receipts remained at their spawn state after abrupt Windows termination; row.stopped was false and row.result absent. The escalation fixture uses an ignore-signals child while explicitly expecting Windows forceful SIGTERM; that branch does not prove escalation, and abrupt parent termination need not leave a completed inner receipt. These observations require a verification-contract correction, not a claimed process leak or fabricated runner result. All five separate actual Cargo calls passed with complete successful retained receipts; they do not prove cancellation or escalation.

Goals.Goal: Preserve parent SIGINT130/SIGTERM143, exact source/digest/PID ownership, bounded cancellation, native-process/path absence and finally cleanup on every platform.
Keep complete POSIX cooperative inner-runner assertions, and explicitly prove Windows abrupt parent recovery without inventing an inner result, native close/reap receipt or exact termination cause.
Add actual direct runExecutable cancellation controls where the runner survives and records complete native close/result/cleanup evidence for both signals.

Prove escalation in actual runOwned around a real task-owned child using a controlled first exact SIGTERM no-op followed by real exact SIGKILL, close, absence and cleanup, while an unrelated sentinel remains alive.

Production tools/run-rust-tests.mjs SHA256 remains d229ca8410a34382285ece7d836b17717019125487c1710c4e16d32a96fe293e byte-for-byte. No helper/API, workflow, cache, action pin, dependency, runtime source, other test, existing archive or approved body edits.

Retain both parent cancellation tests and expected statuses130/143, exact nativePID/source/path/SHA checks, owned paths absent, positive valid controls and existing POSIX completed/reaped/cancelled/cooperative-exit0 assertions. On Windows assert final parent recovery state and no cleanup errors, stopped Cargo, owned artifact unavailable and actual native absence; retain any incomplete runner spawn receipt honestly instead of normalizing it. Windows may also finish the runner before parent termination: accept a genuinely complete record only with its actual result/reap/cleanup assertions; never require an incomplete record as a timing outcome.

Direct cancellation imports actual runExecutable and runOwned; do not copy their implementation into a fake controller. Use real temporary executable children and existing injectable signal/spawn boundaries. For each direct runExecutable signal, require actual recorded native identity, close/reaped result, cancelled flag, stopped, unavailable artifact, empty cleanupErrors and OS absence. Preserve Windows forceful-signal vs POSIX cooperative differences explicitly.

Escalation adapter delegates to actual spawn, intercepts only the first exact SIGTERM request to that owned child as a no-op, records the attempted request and verifies the child remains alive; actual subsequent SIGKILL delegates to that same child. Assert ordered signals, same owned PID, bounded close/reaped result and absence. Keep an independently owned live sentinel unaffected until normal fixture cleanup. Do not infer Windows escalation from installed JS signal-ignore handlers.

Record artifact/source/path/digest before launch, runner/native PID before releasing controlled input or exec gate, and retain exact signal/result/cleanup receipts outside deleted fixture roots. Reuse production POSIX exec gate where applicable; Windows PID-at-spawn semantics must be identified as such. A direct runOwned test's controlled gate is not evidence that a Windows OS process was recorded before creation.

Every created process and executable belongs to the synthetic fixture. Finally cleanup must await/reap exact owned children, verify absence and delete copies/roots; preserve installed Node/toolchain, dependency/build caches and all unrelated processes. Retain sources/recipes/digests/results, never executables. No Cargo or Rust/Mark build, app, keyring, GUI, signing or real service execution.

No new skip, retry, filter, test timeout, watchdog, grace period, worker count, coverage floor or workflow selection change. Keep existing budgets and behavior controls; do not weaken checks to turn hosted Windows red into green. New direct controls are positive coverage and need not fabricate an old product defect.

Existing real Windows three failures remain original red provenance. Earlier complete actual Cargo receipt proof remains valid only for successful calls on its exact old head.
